description: 3Min API lets you create REST APIs without writing backend code. Define a JSON schema, and get full CRUD endpoints with automatic webhook delivery, sandbox/production separation, real-time logs, and usage statistics. Manage everything through natural language — create endpoints, test API calls, search logs, invite collaborators, deploy to production, and generate ready-to-paste WordPress plugin snippets that render your endpoints on any WordPress page.
